evidence_classes.OBSERVED: A real instrument measurement from a mission archive.
evidence_classes.NASA REFERENCE: A published NASA/USGS/partner reference value, catalog or map.
evidence_classes.MODELED: Output of a physical model (e.g. NASA Ames Mars GCM).
evidence_classes.DERIVED: Computed by NeuroNexus from observed or modeled inputs.
evidence_classes.COMPUTED: Geometry or arithmetic computed by NeuroNexus.
evidence_classes.SIMULATED: A configurable NeuroNexus simulation value, not a measurement.
evidence_classes.AI INTERPRETATION: Language-model interpretation of structured results; never a NASA observation.

ingestion_statuses.INGESTED: Data are read and used by the pipeline.
ingestion_statuses.QUERIED LIVE: Fetched from the provider at run time (cached).
ingestion_statuses.REFERENCE ONLY: Linked for context; the data are not ingested.
ingestion_statuses.CATALOGED NOT INGESTED: Registered but not ingested; nothing is inferred from it.
ingestion_statuses.UNAVAILABLE: Known but not reachable or not usable.

legacy_export.purpose: External-source and provenance ledger for the NeuroNexus Mars mission-planning and scientific intelligence system.

provenance_boundary.external_sources: Authoritative or external datasets, APIs, catalogues, models, imagery, and reference material used by NeuroNexus.
provenance_boundary.derived_outputs: Values and classifications calculated by NeuroNexus from external inputs.
provenance_boundary.team_methods: Algorithms, scoring methods, route objectives, and models implemented by the NeuroNexus team.
provenance_boundary.ai_interpretation: Google Gemini interpretation of structured NeuroNexus results; AI prose is never treated as a NASA observation.
provenance_boundary.unavailable: A source or dataset that is known/referenced but not ingested into the application is explicitly marked unavailable or not_ingested rather than replaced with invented data.

evidence_statuses.USED: External source actively used by an application subsystem.
evidence_statuses.USED_AND_INGESTED: External source data are locally ingested/indexed and used by the scientific pipeline.
evidence_statuses.USED_AS_REFERENCE: External source supports scientific or mission context but is not necessarily a locally ingested measurement dataset.
evidence_statuses.USED_AS_REFERENCE_ONLY: External source is linked/referenced for context; the underlying full dataset is not ingested.
evidence_statuses.CATALOGUED_NOT_INGESTED: The source is registered in the science catalogue/provenance roadmap but its data are not currently ingested for site-specific calculations.
evidence_statuses.UNAVAILABLE: The source is known but unavailable in the current runtime; NeuroNexus does not fabricate a substitute.
